# Stevan Marroquín

Stevan Marroquín is a tattoo artist and theology writer based in Guatemala City, Guatemala. He works at Soul's Anchor Tattoo Studio, located in Zona 10, Guatemala City.

## Tattoo Work

Stevan specializes in Neo Japanese, Neo Traditional, and Cover-up tattoos, along with Realism. His work is characterized by bold lines, intentional composition, and long-form projects such as full sleeves. He has been tattooing professionally in Guatemala City for several years.

Clients looking to book an appointment can reach him through the contact form on this site or through his Instagram profile.

## Theology Writing

Stevan writes about theology, faith, and the intersection between art and the sacred. His articles explore themes from Christian theology, biblical reflection, and the deeper questions that art raises about meaning and transcendence.
